Colophon: All the rest. The whole economy pays the Amazon tax (permalink) Selling on Amazon is a tough business. Sure, you can reach a lot of customers, but this comes at a very high price: the junk fees that Amazon extracts from its sellers amount to 50-60% of the price you pay. That's a hell of a lot of money to hand over to a middleman, but it's not like vendors have much choice.
